name: aura
title: Aura
description: A raymarched field of glowing, winding light lines in one WebGL 2 shader: a spectral fan rising from a point, with tint, speed and exposure props.
label: Aura (CodePen)
author: Sabo Sugi <https://codepen.io/sabosugi>

props.name: playing
props.description: Plays the animation; false holds the current frame.

props.name: time
props.description: Shows one moment (seconds of animation) and stops the clock, for stills.

props.name: exposure
props.description: Divides the light before tone mapping, 200 to 8000: lower is brighter.

props.name: lineWidth
props.description: Width of the bright line cores, 0 to 0.05.

props.name: lineHeight
props.description: Vertical stretch of the lines, 0.1 to 5.

props.name: warpFrequency | warpSmoothness
props.description: How tightly the lines wind (0.1 to 6) and how quickly the winding fades at fine detail (0 to 5).

props.name: raySteps
props.description: Ray marching steps, 21 to 150: more is smoother and slower.

props.name: dpr
props.description: The exact pixel ratio of the drawing buffer, 0.5 to 3. Upstream draws at 1 on every screen.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Replaces the static picture shown without WebGL 2 and before the first frame.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Reports the loop status, for example to hide playback controls without WebGL 2.

a11y: Decorative by default (aria-hidden); with aria-label it is role="img" with that name.
Reduced motion: the field stops on one still frame (the shader's picture at 12 s); nothing moves. Without WebGL 2 a CSS picture of the fan shows instead.
usage: <Aura aria-label="A fan of glowing light lines" className="rounded-lg" />
